about_the_game:
Redacted – MVP (Minimum Viable Product) Release

In the near future, a mysterious and advanced district, codenamed "Genesis," becomes the epicenter of a covert genetic experiment gone catastrophically wrong.

This MVP version of Redacted Genome—simply titled Redacted—serves as the first step in delivering the full vision of the game and the launch point for the larger Franchise Redacted.

Players take on the role of Levi, a skilled special operations soldier sent into Genesis after the elite H.O.P.E. (Hostile Opposition Prevention and Elimination) team goes silent. What he finds is a once-thriving city consumed by grotesque mutations and overrun with horrors born from corrupted genetic experimentation.

As Levi navigates the desolate, decaying streets, players will uncover early pieces of the mystery surrounding the redacted genome project, engage in intense third- or first-person combat, and face evolving threats that require both strategic thinking and raw firepower.

This MVP version features:

  • A vertical slice of the core gameplay mechanics

  • Tense and atmospheric exploration within key sectors of Genesis

  • Introductory narrative elements, including audio logs and documents from the fallen H.O.P.E. team

  • A haunting soundtrack and striking visual contrasts between the utopia Genesis was and the nightmare it has become

By supporting Redacted, you’re not just playing a game—you’re helping build the foundation for the complete Redacted Genome experience and the future of the Franchise Redacted. Your feedback, support, and early engagement will directly influence the scope, direction, and development of what's to come.

Genesis has fallen. The truth begins here.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of suicide, gore, and various other elements visualized in a warzone.
